description: A full-stack AI Red Teaming platform securing AI ecosystems via Agent Scan, Skills Scan, MCP scan, AI Infra scan and LLM jailbreak evaluation.

written.description: Gathers several separate AI security scans behind one console: the agent, the MCP servers, the skills, the serving infrastructure, and a jailbreak pass against the model itself.

alive.last_commit_message:
feat(cli): add JSON scan output (#682)

Adds a --json flag to ai-infra-guard scan that emits results as a JSON array of the existing HttpResult schema (reusing the schema, no new structs), plus --output to write the payload to a file. Refactors result emission into callbackScanResult/reportScanScore, leaving the default text path unchanged.

Local verification (head dccf4f0d merged into current main):
- go build ./... -> PASS
- go test ./... -> PASS (EXIT=0, no regressions vs main)
- go test ./common/runner/ -run TestResultsJSON -> PASS (full-schema round-trip)
- CLI smoke: scan --json end-to-end emits a valid JSON array; --output writes the same payload

Known non-blocking nit (not a merge blocker): the ASCII banner still prints to stdout in --json mode and breaks '| jq'; suggest suppressing it or moving it to stderr in a follow-up.

Co-authored-by: wangyusheng1985 <wangyusheng1985@users.noreply.github.com>
